title: pyrrocoma lucida
intro: Pyrrocoma lucida, commonly known as Rocky Mountain woolly heads, is a flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of North America. It is used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety, making it a popular remedy for stress relief and promoting a good night's sleep. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, which have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. These properties also contribute to its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function.
